summary.text: Greg Hill, listed by Ballotpedia as Gregory Hill, is a Republican state representative from Merrimack District 2 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary. Ballotpedia lists his career experience as financial services professional.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Hill as chair of the Legislative Administration Committee and a member of the House Transportation Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
It also lists earlier assignments to the Education Committee in 2011-2012, Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services in 2015, Election Law in 2017, and Legislative Administration in 2019-2020.
